name: dealhound
description: Find products that fit your needs and budget, compare useful options, and shop through convenient Amazon product links.

interface.longDescription: Make your next purchase a smarter one. Tell your agent what you need, your budget and where you shop. DealHound helps your agent discover relevant physical products, compare options and look for better value, then provides convenient Amazon.com product links so you can decide what to buy. From everyday essentials to your next upgrade, spend less time hunting and more time choosing what fits. Your agent uses its available browsing tools. Amazon.com is currently the supported affiliate merchant. Check the retailer for current prices, discounts, stock, sizes and shipping. Affiliate links include a clear disclosure; qualifying purchases may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. Savings are not guaranteed. Searches happen when you ask; DealHound does not place orders or monitor prices in the background.
defaultPrompt: Help me find good-value ASICS trail shoes in men’s US 9.5 on Amazon.com.
Find a quiet mechanical keyboard under $100 for delivery in the US.
Help me save on my next purchase. Ask what I need and my budget.
